text:
jamie: Heads-up — seeing customers hit duplicate billing when clients reconnect/resume after proxy idle timeouts. Low volume but high signal. Logs attached below.

micah: Can you paste the raw headers and resume token flow?

jamie: Sure. example request/response sequence: 
```
Client -> /stream?resume=true  Authorization: Bearer xxxxx Resume-Token: rtoken-abc
200 OK  Stream starts, resume accepted
...proxy idle timeout kills connection after ~10m (no data)
Client reconnects -> /stream?resume=true  Authorization: Bearer xxxxx Resume-Token: rtoken-abc
200 OK  Stream resumed, but backend created new billing entry instead of resuming cost bucket
```

anya: Are we certain it's the proxy idle timeout and not a resume token replay protection kicking in?

jamie: We correlated with proxy LB logs — the LB drops the TCP connection but the resume token TTL on the backend is still valid. The backend accepts resume but doesn't merge into the original session's billing bucket. Billing pipeline treats resumed connection as new session id.

zane: That matches a theory: we use opaque session ids for billing that are generated at accept-time. Resume currently reconstructs state but we don't map it back to the original billing id. So resume -> new billing id.

ida: Console telemetry shows a bump in `resume_attempts` and `session_creates` but `resume_success` looks fine. That explains dup-charge alerts. Pulled metric: https://console.internal/metrics?query=duplicate_resume_count (link only internal).

console-bot: alert: duplicate_resume_rate > 0.5% for PROD region-us-west; top tenant: acme-inc.

micah: Two possible mitigations: 1) server-side dedupe where we map resume-token -> original billing id (store last_seen_resume_id) 2) client-side: enhance SDK to prefer exponential backoff + jitter and prefer a fresh session if time since last active > threshold. Which should be priority?

zane: Server-side dedupe is safer and transparent to customers. Implementation sketch: when a resume token is used, check Redis for `resume:${token}:billing_id` with TTL=30m. If present, reuse billing id instead of allocating new one. Also increment `duplicate_resume_count` telemetry when a resume maps to existing billing id.

anya: Agree, but watch race window: two parallel reconnect attempts could both miss the map and allocate two billing ids. Need CAS/lock or token->lease atomic set (`SET NX`) semantics. Potentially use `SET resume:${token}:billing_id ${id} NX PX 1800000` then read.

jamie: Good catch. Also need to ensure this logic works across Dedicated and Private modes (different state backends). Add abstraction in runtime to call `resumeStore.getOrCreate(token, createFn)` so different deployments can implement atomic semantics.

ida: From telemetry side I'll add a dashboard tile showing `resume_attempts`, `resume_success`, `duplicate_resume_count`, and a heatmap by proxy node. This will help validate canary.

micah: UX/console question: during a rollout we surface fallback policies: `prefer-sticky-lease` vs `prefer-resume` — do we need a new toggle to force dedupe behavior? Might confuse customers. Maybe expose as advanced flag and default to dedupe on behalf of customers.

zane: Default to dedupe server-side. Provide a debug flag in console for SREs to toggle behavior per tenant during canary.

jamie: I'll prototype server-side patch. Plan: implement `resumeStore` adapter, add `SET NX` semantics, emit telemetry when dedupe occurs, add a small console toggle under tenant advanced settings for rollout testing.

micah: Who owns the billing mapping change? I'll take the runtime patch and tests. jamie owns console toggle + dashboards. ida owners telemetry. zane will review for Distributed locks.

deploy-bot: scheduling: canary window requested Tue 03:00-06:00 UTC.

jamie: Can we also add a short-term mitigation at proxy layer: extend idle timeouts for active streaming clients to reduce churn while we ship? Ops?

ida: I can add a metric alarm and temporary LB tweak for top 3 nodes in us-west for the next 48h.

micah: Ok plan LGTM. Add unit tests: resume mapping race simulation + integration test exercising Redis `SET NX` failure/retry.

zane: Also add an integration test where two simultaneous resumes for the same token must end up with same billing_id (or one blocked). Document behavior in runtime API docs.

jamie: I'll open a PR with summary, design, and test plan. Link will be posted here.

sentry-bot: issue created: INF-4237 duplicate billing on resume. Priority: P2.

micah: Cool. After PR merged we do canary. If metrics look good, roll to prod and remove LB temporary tweak.

jamie: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/7891 (will update when ready) :thumbsup:
